svg.text: Speed, worst-wheel slip and tyre utilisation against distance
The bottom panel is the one that matters: the policy is at the friction limit for 0.7% of the lap and below a
tenth of it for the rest. Slip peaks at 9.7°, inside the 12° fit, so the lap is quotable (rule 4) — but the car
is limited by the speed cap, not by grip.
[MEASURED] curr_ct2_policy.pt, deployed (mean-action) policy, speed_cap 13 m/s (the cap the checkpoint was selected under),
cross_track_penalty 2, Spa via tracks_data.load_real_track, offset-free tire. Rung 2 of the fidelity ladder (double-track): per-wheel loads
and load transfer, no roll camber, roll steer or compliance.
